Duosion

Psychic

Unova · Generation 5

Duosion is a Psychic-type Mitosis Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8 kg. It evolves from Solosis and into Reuniclus. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 370.
